segments.title: Your iPhone knows where you PARKED
segments.sub: No app, no pin, **already built in**
segments.say: Your iPhone already knows where you parked.

segments.title: It drops a pin when you LEAVE
segments.sub: When you disconnect from **CarPlay or car Bluetooth**
segments.say: When you disconnect from your car's CarPlay or Bluetooth, Maps drops a marker.

segments.title: Turn it on in 3 taps
segments.say: Open Settings, then Apps, then Maps, and turn on Show Parked Location. Significant Locations needs to be on too.

segments.title: Find it: search PARKED CAR
segments.say: To find your car, search Parked Car in Maps and tap Directions.
Follow for Phone Trick number 14 tomorrow.
